Rebuilt from CURRENT MAIN ot_s81sl_rstop (S81-SMWIRE CI_XB own delivery + V train) as: 31 kept capture copies (every header/valid/strap port bit = 31 copy flops + <= 1 data flop = 32 loads), 92 kept 12-bit select leaves (own state replicas, registered strap decode, priority one-hot selects driving <= 12 bit muxes; the 276-b own fragment merge computed once, 3 b per leaf), a kept master (scalar valids / fault / NX valids / gather family-index select), and a kept 2 -> 6 -> 48 region reset tree (port drives 2 flops, every region <= 23 reset loads, payload reset-free). RELAY = 1 on every output incl. the gather port g_* (fault direct). rs_equiv (tools/s81_slice/rs_equiv.sh, Verilator 5.050): 13 cases x 20k edges vs main rstop + one-edge tb relay -- 8 random (faulting header windows), 3 protocol-legal (fault 0 throughout, line/own/V/ci-XB/NX all covered), 2 in-flight reset -- 0 mismatches; 6 mutants (slice / cixb / frag / vasm / gswap / tiercol) FAIL. SAFE checklist (owner 10-19): 1 pins waived-with-reason (source-registered: every input lands in a pin flop, every output leaves a relay flop; reset_landing 2 stages ON). 2 reach fixed: every pin-to-pin path is pin flop -> select stage p -> relay q (two hops of <= ~432 um across an 864-wide tile; gather W/E -> S also relayed). 3 fanout fixed by construction (<= 32, checked by the gate's mandatory mapped native census before floorplan). 4 depth PASS: priority one-hot decode (~6 levels) + 6-way AND-OR + hops-1. 5 storage PASS: own / V / ci-train slots 3 x 828 b + 2 x 1104 b, constant-index decoded writes, no runtime index, no shift chain (ci V train is a 3-slot buffer read by registered one-hot). 6 floorplan waived-with-reason: pin-bound leaf without macros, outline from face pin density <= 5.8/um, width 864 = the x streamer leaf's g_d abutment. 7 clock: clock_split_km regional roots (variant K), spread judged TT+FF <= 80; io_hold_margin 0.03. 8 schedule: +1 edge per stop on line / V / NX / control deliveries and +1 edge on the gather port vs current main rstop (RELAY = 1 contract) -> handed to MU.S81.CAL to price; protocol unchanged.
